explication: SmartYouTubeTV is an Android TV YouTube client whose main journey is remote- or intent-driven navigation into video playback. The README documents WebView and Crosswalk browser choices, ExoPlayer playback, resolution/codec selection, login, and TV-oriented controls. The graph preserves those product branches and the sampled browser, player, preferences, and key-handling layers. Several domain relationships are documented rather than visible in sampled implementation; those links are dashed or cited to the README, and unsampled details are not inferred.
